_README: EVENT TYPES A HUMAN HAS RULED ON.
This is NOT the counting rule - that is CALENDLY_EVENT_TYPES in the env, and
it stays exactly as Moayad set it (2026-08-17: everything except onboarding).
This file answers a different question: has anyone LOOKED at this event type.
Whatever shape the counting rule takes, it decides silently for anything new -
a deny-list counts every new type, an allow-list drops every new type. Both
have already cost real numbers here. `npm run check:calendly` compares the
calendar against this list and speaks up only when something is missing from
it, so it stays quiet until Brey's team invents an event type.
When a NEW type appears: decide whether it is a sales call, change
CALENDLY_EVENT_TYPES if that decision needs enforcing, then add it here.
